about_the_game:
The first part of the game. The Shadow Cosmos is a 3D metroidvania action game with retro aesthetic. Explore an interconnected world, gain new abilities, collect shadows and fight with your halberd. As master peacock, delve into a mysterious world, find the king and take his shadow.

Features:

  • Low-poly visuals

  • Deep combat and movement systems

  • Interconnected world

  • Power ups

  • Difficult gameplay

content_descriptors.notes: The game features frequent fantasy fights (without blood)
